data.acquisitionSummary: SpeakOut now uses an active-plan model rather than the legacy 365-day airtime-voucher model. The current physical SIM is CA$10; current plans start at CA$19/30 days and an annual talk/text plan is CA$125/360 days. Service is cancelled after 90 days with no active rate plan.

keep.action: Keep an active plan or purchase a new plan before the 90-day no-active-plan cancellation window ends. The cheapest currently listed monthly plan is CA$19/30 days; the old CA$25-per-365-day voucher rule is no longer the current service model.

data.chinaActivation: Online activation is available, but SpeakOut service is restricted to Canada and current help/terms say it does not roam outside Canada. It is not an overseas OTP route.
data.kyc: No credit check is advertised. Current service terms collect customer-identifying/contact information for activation; do not generalize this into a no-KYC legal claim.
data.payment: SIMs and plans can be purchased online; account top-ups are available online by credit card or via Canadian 7-Eleven vouchers.
data.wifiCalling: Not relied on for this route decision.
data.roamingSms: Not supported for the target use case. Current SpeakOut help/terms say service does not roam outside Canada and calls cannot be made or received outside Canada.
data.refund: SIM cards and prepaid service credits are non-refundable under current help/terms.
data.holdReason: Current product no longer supports the legacy CA$25/365-day retention model and does not roam outside Canada, so it cannot serve the overseas SMS/OTP job.
data.tariffSummary: CA$10 physical SIM; current plans start CA$19/30d; account cancels after 90 days without an active plan; no roaming outside Canada.
guideSteps: Reference/HOLD only — do not use the legacy 365-day voucher economics.
For Canada-only use, maintain an active rate plan and never let the no-active-plan period reach 90 days.
